summary: Authority is a protected Git-backed control-plane journal, distinct from product repositories. Historical sharded journal branches remain described in its README, while current Coordination source also defines an explicit protected-main directory profile. Main mutation requires existing main, precise protection anchors, a frozen epoch identity, expected-parent compare/exchange and preservation of unrelated tree state. Missing state cannot self-bootstrap authority; uncertain effects require reconciliation rather than blind replay. README branch/actor descriptions are historical navigation and should not substitute for the selected current profile and native policy observation.
title: Authority journal profiles and frozen epoch gates
